title: The Girl on a Broomstick
writer: Hermína Franková, Milos Macourek, Václav Vorlícek
actors: Petra Cernocká, Jan Hrusínský, Jan Kraus
plot: Saxana, a witch-in-training, accidentally stumbles upon a spell that transports her to the human world. She meets Peter who introduces her to the human world, leading to a series of adventures as she experiences life outside magic...
